methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch. Where the official page rendered JS-only or returned errors, reputable aggregator pages (SoftwareAdvice, GetApp, Zapier blog) were used as primary source and noted in provenance. All prices are USD. Per-seat plans show the cost for one seat/user as the smallest billable unit. Annual prices are the effective monthly rate (annual total divided by 12). Month-to-month rates are noted in plan notes where both billing periods are published. Vendors with no public self-serve price are included with null monthlyUsd. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 for all sources.

vendors.name: Toggl Track
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://toggl.com/track/pricing/ fetched directly and corroborated by Tekpon and CostBench listings. Starter is $9/user/month annual ($10 month-to-month); Premium is $18/user/month annual ($20 month-to-month). The displayed $9/$18 figures are the ANNUAL rates; the 'Save 10%' applies between annual and the higher monthly rates.

limits: Free plan is limited to small teams (small user count)
Billable rates, project time estimates, and revenue/profitability reporting require Starter or higher (not on Free)
Customizable/scheduled reports, Jira & Salesforce sync, and SSO are Premium-only
Free plan excludes data-accuracy features such as locking time entries and audit logs
keyFeatures: One-click time tracking with timer (web, desktop, mobile)
Browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) tracking time inside 100+ tools
Billable rates and invoicing (e.g. send invoices to QuickBooks Online)
Project and team management with billable/profitability analysis
100+ native integrations plus a public API
bestFor: Freelancers and solopreneurs tracking billable time
Small-to-mid agencies and consultancies billing clients by project
Distributed/remote teams needing lightweight time tracking and reporting
enrichment.provenance: Fetched the pricing page (confirmed $0 free-forever plan and a 30-day free trial of paid plans), the integrations page, and two of Toggl's own security pages (/track/security-and-reliability/ and /legal/security/), which both explicitly state SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance. HIPAA is null because neither security page mentions HIPAA or a BAA; absence is not denial.
